exposure: Timing of final intrauterine transfusion (IUT) (>= 34 weeks 0 days vs. < 34 weeks 0 days)
outcome: Procedure-related complications (rupture of membranes or preterm delivery, intrauterine infection, fetal death, fetal compromise resulting in emergency cesarean, neonatal death)
cohort: The study included 94 pregnancies that received intrauterine transfusions (IUTs).
finding: Procedure-related complications of IUT were rare (1.3% of procedures, 3.2% of pregnancies), and IUT performed at or beyond 34 weeks of gestation appeared safe.
mod_finding: All three observed procedure-related complications resulted in emergency cesarean section.
gest_age: Gestational age at IUT; Gestational age at delivery
